family.description: This domain is found at the C-terminal of Highly reducing polyketide synthase sdgA from Emericella nidulans and related proteins. SdgA is part of the gene cluster that mediates the biosynthesis of the polyenes aspernidgulenes [[cite:PUB00155054]]. This domain is predicted to adopt an all alpha-helical structure.
family.name: Highly reducing polyketide synthase sdgA, C-terminal ACP domain
